issues.title: Get error when clean copy wargame
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Get error when clean copy wargame

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to admin page
2. Click action 'Clean Copy' on a wargame
3. Notice no new wargame is create and it shows the error on console

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/6d1bae84-f913-4670-9142-7b57c20ba1a0)
4. Refresh page, I can see the new game is created 

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/70930001-0834-43d9-84df-98b57ed8b90b)


Note : issue is also happen with 'Duplicate' , 'Delete', 'Hide' wargame

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
No error when clean copy a wargame

## 🖥️ Screencast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/e4ac8bb4-c165-43a6-a9a7-1773c95ca6cf



## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
